design_rules: One stable operation ID per user intent across retries.
Accepted effects are at-most-once and status lookup resolves ambiguous failure.
Expected-version checks prevent stale silent overwrite.
Live/async/hybrid cadence share one Campaign/Event history.
Offline use remains read-only authoritative state plus approved local drafts; no offline authoritative mutation.
implementation_boundary: APW-07 is completed_verified; APW-I identifiers remain inactive until APW-08 final handoff and explicit roadmap activation.
